ездить.gloss: to go (by vehicle, habitually or round-trip)

meanings.en: to go by vehicle, to travel (habitually or there and back)

meanings.note: Каждый день = every day. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('every, each').

Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'жраться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'get hammered'.

examples.text: Лева, я ведь все равно нажерусь.
Он пообещал жене сегодня вечером не нажраться на банкете.
examples.trans: He promised his wife not to get wasted at the banquet tonight.

examples.text: Как ты умудрился так быстро нажраться посреди рабочего дня?
examples.trans: How did you manage to get hammered so fast in the middle of a workday?

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

получиться.gloss: to turn out, to work out

meanings.en: to turn out, to work out
meanings.note: Всё получилось = it all worked out. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'лучиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to turn out, to work out', paired with 'получаться'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'купать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'buy up'.

examples.text: Вы будете скупать алкоголь во всех магазинах.

examples.text: Этот коллекционер годами скупает редкие французские вина.

meanings.note: To set in place ready for use. Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'становить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to establish, set up, install'.
